notes.title: Patch v1.0.2 Hotfix
notes.notes: - Fixed an issue where players were unable to access the options menu after manually resizing the window

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for playing reporting bugs, if you encountered any - here's the next set of fixes!

Patch notes:
- Added the ability to delete your savegame from MainMenu->Options->Game Settings
- Improved performance in final level
- More minor bugfixes

notes.title: Patch Notes for v1.0.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
thank you so much for playing WHALIEN! We've addressed a few issues that came up during the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38104262/6f89a392400d8bcb879159237350115dfb993688.png[/img]

Patch notes:
[list]
[*] Prevent players from manually toggling fullscreen mode using F11
[*] Fixed bug in video options menu
[*] Fixed some minor gameplay bugs
[/list]

notes.title: WHALIEN - Unexpected Guests Release 🐳
notes.notes:
We’ve been eagerly awaiting this moment! After a ton of concepting, designing, programming and testing, [b]WHALIEN - Unexpected Guests[/b] is finally ready for the public. We are so happy to finally have all of you playing the game and hearing your feedback!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38104262/39443b54cbe843182ad8e981bfccff043ac46309.gif[/img]
Release Patch Notes:
[list]
[*]General performance improvements
[*]Added Achievements
[*]Fixed a few visual bugs
[*]Fixed potential crash in latter half of game
[*]Improved overall experience
[/list]
We wish you a fintastic adventure in the Whale,
the team at Forbidden Folds

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38104262/c78b07fecc8b951696ecfd9c66d09bbbf6be5302.gif[/img]

P.S.: If you encounter any bugs or glitches, please do report them to us in the forum. That way we can continue making WHALIEN - Unexpected Guests the smoothest possible experience!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
There are unexpected guests on the Doorstep!

In WHALIEN you Push and Pull your way through a heartfelt adventure! Fin, the mechanical whale you call home, is plagued by mischievous Squiddies. As Ernest Hemingwhale you set out on a Fin-tastic journey to help your friend with his unexpected guests. 

We are overjoyed to announce that WHALIEN - Unexpected Guests will be released on January 24th. 
Wishlist now to be notified on release.

[previewyoutube=CHnBLMlsa9E;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
This time we have more of an announcement than development insights. 

Starting this week, we are going to take a break from our biweekly DevLog because WHALIEN is entering a crucial development stage. 
But don’t worry, when we return in fall we will have some exciting new things to share, alongside more amazingly pixelated gifs.
